scripts.postinstall: npm run install:backend && npm run install:frontend
scripts.db:push: cd backend && npx prisma db push
scripts.db:seed: cd backend && npx prisma db seed
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:n8n"
